Numerous subspecific and varietal names have been proposed. At present (May 2014), 6 such names are recognized: Ophrys omegaifera var. basilissa (C.Alibertis, A.Alibertis & H.R.Reinhard) Faurh - Greece Ophrys omegaifera subsp. dyris (Maire) Del Prete - Spain, Portugal, Morocco, Balearic Islands Ophrys omegaifera subsp. fleischmannii (Hayek) Del Prete - Crete and other Greek islands Ophrys omegaifera subsp. hayekii (H.Fleischm. & Soó) Kreutz - Sicily, Algeria, Tunisia Ophrys omegaifera subsp. israelitica (H.Baumann & Künkele) G.Morschek & K.Morschek - Israel, Palestine, Lebanon, Syria, Turkey, Cyprus, Greece Ophrys omegaifera subsp. omegaifera - Turkey, Greek islands Ophrys omegaifera subsp. apollonae - Turkey, Greek islands
